title: Tell your mother what your cousin said
title_ar: قول لأمك ابن عمك قال إيه

scenario.en: Your cousin sends you a voice message in English. Your mother does not speak English and asks you what he said.
scenario.ar: ابن عمك بعتلك رسالة صوتية بالإنجليزي. أمك مش بتتكلم إنجليزي وسألتك قال إيه.

source: "Hi! Last weekend I worked on Saturday and I studied on Sunday. I visited your grandmother and she cooked fish for me. I called you twice, but your phone was closed."

task.en: Tell your mother the main points of the message.
task.ar: قول لأمك النقط المهمة في الرسالة.

key_points.en: He worked on Saturday and studied on Sunday.
He visited your grandmother and she cooked fish.
key_points.ar: زار جدتك وهي طبخت له سمك.

key_points.en: He called you twice but your phone was closed.
key_points.ar: كلّمك مرتين بس تليفونك كان مقفول.

model_answer.en: He worked on Saturday and studied on Sunday. He visited grandmother and she cooked fish for him. He called you twice, but your phone was closed.
model_answer.ar: اشتغل السبت ودرس الأحد. زار جدتك وطبخت له سمك. وكلّمك مرتين بس تليفونك كان مقفول.
